character: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya's ~3.1km National Circuit — a shortened version of the Grand Prix track that cuts the main straight short and links back before the final sector. It keeps the demanding opening complex and the high-energy sweep onto the back straight, so a well-balanced car and tyre management still matter.
sources: https://www.racingcircuits.info/europe/spain/circuit-de-barcelona-catalunya.html ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_de_Barcelona-Catalunya (National Circuit with chicane 3.071km / without 2.997km) ; https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/circuit-guide-everything-you-need-to-know-about-the-circuit-de-barcelona-catalunya.7i1UoRE8Za0Jk4LI0r68qk — shared corner naming with the GP layout (Elf, Repsol, Seat, Campsa, La Caixa)
notes: Forza labels this 'National Circuit' (3.07km, matching the 3.071km with-chicane figure); a shorter 'National Circuit Alt' (~3.0km, chicane-free) is the separate catalunya-s2 variant. Named corners are the GP-layout names for the shared opening sector; the National layout links back to the pit straight before the GP circuit's final corners.

corners.name: Turn 1 (Elf)
corners.type: medium-speed right into the opening complex
corners.technique: Brake just before the 100m board, late apex, set up the right-left that follows
corners.trap: Getting on the kerb too aggressively into the sequence

corners.name: Turn 3
corners.technique: Carry momentum from the opening turns, smooth exit toward Repsol
corners.trap: Over-driving the T1 entry compromises the entire opening complex

corners.name: Repsol
corners.technique: Early apex and slowest point, get the speed reduction done early in the corner
corners.trap: Going in too deep ruins the exit onto the following straight

corners.name: Seat
corners.technique: A clean exit is everything — it feeds the longest straight; sacrifice entry speed for exit drive
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running wide on exit

corners.name: Würth
corners.technique: Brake at the entry kerb, use the camber for grip, smooth through the direction change, early power
corners.trap: Snap oversteer on throttle application at the apex

corners.name: Campsa
corners.type: fast, blind right over a crest onto the back straight (Turn 9)
corners.technique: Critical corner — commit over the crest, late apex, progressive throttle for the straight
corners.trap: Lifting over the blind crest scrubs speed down the whole straight

corners.name: La Caixa
corners.technique: Brake after the 100m board, turn in tidily, avoid the inside kerbs
corners.trap: Locking up on the downhill approach
